headline: US secretly conducted limited strikes on Iran for weeks before the midterms, including the Monday Nov 2 Qeshm Island strike

Some officials described the assaults as defensive, to…
sources: Wall Street Journal (T2, originator), citing US officials; Associated Press (T1) via anonymous US official; President Trump on-record on Fox News
fault_line: Did Trump secretly restart the war before the election while telling voters there had been no fighting for months -- or were these small defensive strikes that changed nothing?

sections.what_happened: [ATTRIBUTED -- WSJ, citing US officials] The US attacked Iran's Qeshm Island on Monday Nov 2, the latest of a series of limited strikes Washington has secretly carried out against Iran in recent weeks even as Trump touted a diplomatic deal. Some officials described the assaults as defensive, to prevent Iran attacking commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz. On Monday, the IRGC fired a surface-to-air missile at a US fighter jet, which fired back in self-defense; separately US forces intercepted an IRGC missile launched from Qeshm at commercial shipping. Unlike earlier in the war, the US has not publicly announced the attacks; 'purposefully keeping the campaign quiet so as not to signal any intention of resuming major combat operations'. Adm. Brad Cooper (CENTCOM chief) visited the White House last week to brief Trump; CENTCOM has moved more missile defenses and munitions into the region. The US has told Gulf nations to prepare for a short and intense operation shortly after the election. [CORROBORATED -- AP, T1, via Thai PBS Verify and urdupro relay] AP, also citing US officials, reported the US launched defensive strikes against Iranian targets in the Strait of Hormuz after Iran allegedly used anti-aircraft missiles against US assets; a US official told AP the strikes hit Iranians 'using surface-to-air missiles against US assets'. [ON-RECORD -- Trump, Fox News, Nov 2-3] Trump confirmed the Qeshm strike, calling it a 'minor attack': 'As soon as it was finished, we hit it last night, very nicely.' Target was an anti-aircraft facility Iran had spent about two months building. On Hannity Monday night: 'This isn't war. This is a very soft war... There hasn't been shooting for months.' [ADDITIONAL ATTRIBUTED, via urdupro relay] CBS News: a senior US official said the Revolutionary Guard had fired at an American aircraft before the strike; Axios: a US fighter jet eliminated a surface-to-air launcher in self-defence. [CONTEXT] IRNA/Fars reported multiple explosions on Qeshm late Nov 2 and near Bandar Lengeh; the last known US strikes before Monday dated to early September (AP).
sections.what_verified: 3 tiered families: WSJ (T2, originator of the secret-weeks series) + AP (T1, confirms the defensive Qeshm strike via anonymous US official) + Axios (T2, via urdupro relay, confirms the fighter-jet/SAM-launcher self-defence exchange). Trump on-record on Fox confirms the Qeshm strike itself. The 'series over several weeks' detail remains WSJ-only anonymous sourcing. Eastora, Gujaratsamachar, China Daily, EA WorldView, urdupro are relays with NO declared tier and do not add corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: Trump told reporters Nov 2 that American forces 'had not been engaged in combat for months' and 'we haven't been doing any fighting for months' -- directly contradicted by the strikes his own officials describe. No formal Pentagon statement has been issued; Israel denied involvement (AFP). Viral footage purporting to show the Qeshm strike is AI-GENERATED (Thai PBS Verify: InVID-WeVerify anomalies, Meta AI 'highly likely AI', Hive Detect 65-75% AI probability) -- the military incidents are real, the circulating video is not; never use it as strike footage. IRGC framing competes: it says it fired the SAM first / intercepted a US missile -- the defensive sequence is contested between the two sides' accounts.
sections.why_matters: He said there had been no fighting for months. His own officials say the US had been secretly bombing Iran for weeks -- and hit Qeshm Island the night before Americans voted.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (WSJ, Nov 5; Eastora relay 2026-11-05T13:16:09+03:00 = 15:16 ; Trump Fox confirmation Nov 2-3) -- US secretly conducted limited strikes on Iran for weeks before the midterms, including the Monday Nov 2 Qeshm Island strike; Trump publicly said Nov 2 that US forces 'had not been engaged in combat for months'

totw_analysis: Our read: He said there had been no fighting for months. His own officials say the US had been secretly bombing Iran for weeks -- and hit Qeshm Island the night before Americans voted. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Did Trump secretly restart the war before the election while telling voters there had been no fighting for months -- or were these small defensive strikes that changed nothing?
